dialogue.content: （本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for being here today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日は相談に来てくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I’m the counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: はじめに、年齢・性別・相談内容を教えていただけますでしょうか。差支えない範囲で大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to talk about today? You only need to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 28歳　女性
dialogue.English: 28 years old, female.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。今日はどのようなことをお話したいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 子供が週何回かわがままを言って幼稚園を休みます
dialogue.English: My child acts up a few times a week and refuses to go to kindergarten.

dialogue.content: なるほどそれは困ってしまいますね、、
dialogue.English: I see, that must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月間こんな感じで、職場にも迷惑かけているし、わたしも子供から離れる時間が欲しくてイライラします
dialogue.English: This has been going on for three months, it's causing issues at work, and I get frustrated because I need some time away from my child.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそのような状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.content: 入れ違ってしまいました、失礼いたしました
dialogue.English: Our messages crossed, my apologies.

dialogue.content: ３か月間という長い間、悩まれていらっしゃったのですね、、
dialogue.English: So you’ve been struggling with this for as long as three months.

dialogue.content: どう子供を説得したらいいかわかりません
dialogue.English: I don’t know how to persuade my child.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、お子さんにどう接していったらよいか、悩まれてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it's understandable to be worried about how best to interact with your child.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、お子さんのわがままというのは、どのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kinds of behaviors are you referring to when you say your child is acting up?

dialogue.content: 幼稚園にいたくないわたしと一緒に帰るといいます
dialogue.English: They say they don’t want to stay at kindergarten and want to go home with me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、お子さんは、幼稚園にいたくない理由は何か話していましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Has your child mentioned any reason why they don't want to stay at kindergarten?

dialogue.content: いつも幼稚園の前まで行くとわたしにしがみつき、先生には挨拶してますけど
dialogue.English: Whenever we get to the kindergarten gate, they cling to me, though they do say hello to the teacher.

dialogue.content: ええ、、（聴いていますね）
dialogue.English: Yes... (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: どうしたら先生と幼稚園にいてくれるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What can I do to get them to stay at kindergarten with the teacher?

dialogue.content: ええ、一緒に考えてみましょうね
dialogue.English: Yes, let’s think it through together.

dialogue.content: はい。。
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: お話お聞きした感じですと、お子さんは幼稚園の前まではあなたと一緒に行けているのですね
dialogue.English: From what you've said, it sounds like your child is able to go with you right up to the front of the kindergarten.

dialogue.content: おうちを出る時点では、とくにわがままは言わないのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do they not act up at all when you're leaving the house?

dialogue.content: わたしと一緒に家を出るのは嫌じゃないみたいなので
dialogue.English: It seems they don’t mind leaving the house with me.

dialogue.content: 行き先は特に考えてないんですかね？
dialogue.English: Maybe they don’t really think about where we’re going?

dialogue.content: 家の玄関ではそんなに困ったことはないです
dialogue.English: We don’t have much trouble at the front door.

dialogue.content: なるほどあなたと一緒にいることは、お子さんにとってはとても安心できることなのですね。どこに行く用事でも平気なのだろうと、伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: I see—being with you feels very safe for your child. It sounds like they’re okay going anywhere as long as they’re with you.

dialogue.content: お子さんの幼稚園での過ごし方などは、幼稚園の先生から聞かれたりしますか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever hear from the kindergarten teachers about how your child spends their day there?

dialogue.content: 今日はお絵描きしてましたよーとかそういうのはあります
dialogue.English: They tell me things like, “We did some drawing today,” that sort of thing.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、他の子どもたちとの関わりなどは、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. And how are they with the other children?

dialogue.content: 仕事帰りでいつもギリギリなのであまりふかくきいてないかもしれません
dialogue.English: I'm always rushing after work, so I might not have asked in much detail.

dialogue.content: お迎えが
dialogue.English: For pick-up, I mean.

dialogue.content: お仕事帰りですと大変お疲れだと思うので、無理もないと思います
dialogue.English: You must be very tired after work, so that's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、お迎えがギリギリなってしまうのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so the pickup ends up being at the last minute.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、おうちには、他にご家族はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, are there any other family members at home?

dialogue.content: 朝幼稚園でぐずって少し遅れると　なんか定時きっかりに席を立つのもはばかられて
dialogue.English: If morning drop-off runs late because of them fussing at kindergarten, I feel awkward about leaving my desk exactly at quitting time.

dialogue.content: 夫がいます
dialogue.English: I have a husband.

dialogue.content: でも夫は出張も多くて
dialogue.English: But my husband is often away on business trips.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、夫さんは出張も多いのであまり子育てには参加されないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Since your husband is often on business trips, is he not very involved in childcare?

dialogue.content: 分担しても出張でいないときにペースが乱れると思うと　もうじぶんでやったほうがいいかなち
dialogue.English: Even if we were to split the duties, I think about how the routine gets thrown off when he's away on a trip, so I feel like it's just better if I do it myself—

dialogue.content: と思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: —that's what I end up thinking.

dialogue.content: なるほど分担については、出張でいない日以外は協力的なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Regarding sharing duties, is he cooperative on the days he's not away on a business trip?

dialogue.content: 他のお宅がどうかわからないですが　週末家にいる時は子供と遊んでます
dialogue.English: I don't know how it is for other families, but when he's home on the weekends, he plays with our child.

dialogue.content: 今のところ送り迎えとかはお願いしてないです
dialogue.English: As of now, I haven't asked him to do things like drop-offs or pickups.

dialogue.content: 夫さん、週末にはお子さんと遊んでくれているのですね。
dialogue.English: So your husband does play with your child on weekends.

dialogue.content: 送り迎えなどは、夫さんは出張も多くてお願いはしずらい雰囲気でしょうか？
dialogue.English: And for drop-offs and pick-ups, do you feel it's difficult to ask him because he's often away on business trips?

dialogue.content: 残業とかお付き合いとかあったらと思うとためらいます
dialogue.English: I hesitate when I think he might have overtime or work-related social gatherings.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、、夫さんもお仕事や付き合いがあると思うと、お願いするのに気が引けてしまうかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Yes, yes... Thinking about your husband's work and social obligations, it's understandable that you might feel hesitant to ask him.

dialogue.content: あなたの職場の雰囲気もお聞きしたいのですが、職場内でお子さんのいる人は周りにいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I'd also like to ask about the atmosphere at your workplace. Are there other people with children around you at work?

dialogue.content: しょっちゅう今日行けないから交代してって言われたら　私がイラつくんじゃないかとおもって
dialogue.English: I think I would get irritated if he frequently told me, "I can't go today, so can you cover for me?"

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは苛立ってしまいそうですね、、
dialogue.English: I see, that does sound like it would be frustrating.

dialogue.content: なるべくイライラしたくないので挑戦してないですね
dialogue.English: I want to avoid getting irritated, so I haven't tried.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、夫さんの出張は、急に決まることも多いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... Are your husband's business trips often decided on short notice?

dialogue.content: 夫曰く私が彼が1ヶ月前に言ったことを忘れて、明後日から出張とか言われた時に私が初めて聞いたような反応してるらしいです
dialogue.English: According to my husband, I forget what he tells me a month in advance, and when he says something like, "My trip is the day after tomorrow," I apparently react as if I'm hearing it for the first time.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、その時、あなたの反応を見て、夫さんはどんな反応を返してきましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. When he sees your reaction, how does your husband respond?

dialogue.content: 言ったよね、って疲れてるのって聞かれたり
dialogue.English: He'll say things like, "I told you, didn't I?" or ask, "Are you tired?"

dialogue.content: ええ、あなたはどのように言葉を返していますか？
dialogue.English: And how do you respond to that?

dialogue.content: 出張がどうにかできるわけじゃないので　ごめん忘れてたって言います。こういうのがあるから　夫に何かを任せると　私が彼がいない時に色々忘れるかもなと
dialogue.English: It's not like the business trip can be changed, so I just say, "Sorry, I forgot." Because of things like this, I worry that if I rely on my husband for something, I might forget various things when he's not around.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ここまでお話をお伺いしてきて、あなたは仕事に子育てに、相当頑張ってこられていることが伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story so far, it's clear to me that you've been working incredibly hard, juggling both your job and raising your child.

dialogue.content: ご自身としては、どのように思いますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that yourself?

dialogue.content: ただただタスクをこなしてる感じで毎日が過ぎます
dialogue.English: The days just pass by with me feeling like I'm just getting through my tasks.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、職場も定時過ぎまで働いていらして、その後にお迎えや家事などもされていらっしゃると、日々タスクをこなすという感じでも、相当の疲れがたまっているのだろうと思いました。
dialogue.English: I can imagine... Working past your scheduled hours at your job, and then picking up your child and doing housework after that... Even if it feels like just getting through daily tasks, I imagine you must be incredibly exhausted.

dialogue.content: 日々、頑張っている自分を労わってあげてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please be kind to yourself for all the hard work you do every day.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますとりあえず子供が幼稚園に毎日行ってくれれば
dialogue.English: Thank you. For now, if only my child would go to kindergarten every day...

dialogue.content: という思いです
dialogue.English: ...that's my wish.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、ちなみに、お子さんは最近幼稚園に通われ始めたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. By the way, did your child start kindergarten recently?

dialogue.content: 今年の3月です
dialogue.English: This past March.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。もしかしたら、あなたのいない環境にお子さんも戸惑っているところなのかもしれませんね、、
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. It may be that your child is still adjusting to being in an environment without you.

dialogue.content: そうですねわたしも落ち着いてないのが伝わっているのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes, perhaps my own lack of calm is coming through to them.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございましたまた幼稚園の先生と話してみます
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. I’ll try talking with the kindergarten teacher again.

dialogue.content: そのように、感じられるのですねもしかしたら、あなたの気持ちもお子さんに伝わっていたのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That’s how you’re feeling. It may be that your own feelings have been coming across to your child as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、本日はありがとうございます。ぜひ、幼稚園の先生とお子さんのことについてお話ししてみてくださいね。お仕事もあってお忙しいと思うので、少しずつでよいと思いますよ
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for your time today. Please do try to talk with the kindergarten teacher about your child. I know you're busy with work, so I think it's fine to take it one step at a time.

dialogue.content: そうします
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 出来ればお子さんと「幼稚園ではどんなことをしたの？」「何が楽しかった？」などと言ったように、過ごし方などの会話もしてみても良いかもしれません。
dialogue.English: If possible, it might also be good to try having conversations with your child about how they spend their day, asking things like, "What did you do at kindergarten today?" or "What was fun?"

dialogue.content: そうですね考えてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 過ごし方＝幼稚園での過ごし方です。ぜひ、またこちらにもお話に来てくださいね本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: By "how they spend their day," I mean their time at kindergarten. Please feel free to come and talk with us again. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: それでは、終了のメッセージをお送りします
dialogue.English: Now, I will send the closing message.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。それでは、お時間になりますので、ロールプレイを終了させていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. As our time is up, we will now conclude the role-play.)
